# Axon Tickets

Axon Tickets is an online ticketing and event-registration platform for events in the Philippines.

## Public content

- Event listings: https://axontickets.online/
- Event organizer information: https://axontickets.online/organizers
- Event solution guides: https://axontickets.online/solutions/conferences
- Individual event details and ticket availability: https://axontickets.online/events/{event-slug}

Public event pages contain the event title, schedule, venue, city, ticket tiers, prices in Philippine pesos, availability, organizer, and registration link. Ticket availability and event status may change; use the individual event page as the current source of truth.

## Contact

- Website: https://axontickets.online/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/axonentertainment.ph
